question: Which Indian player is also called as Dhing Express?
solution:
The correct answer is __Hima Das.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Hima Das nicknamed the Dhing Express, is an Indian sprinter from Assam of India.
 
• She awarded from Arjuna award in 2018.
 
• Asian Games in 2018, Hima Das won a silver medal in the 4×400-metre mixed relay 
 
• Hima Das won gold in the 400 meters at the IAAF World U20 Championships, clocking 51.46 seconds.
